reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it is framed as a studio interview about Harbhajan Singh's cricket career, public incidents, family, and opinions. The mention of a sports company and clothing for people in the studio does not describe a deceptive viewer solicitation, payment flow, or promised financial return.

citations.quote: Harbhajan Singh in Aap Ki Adalat 2016 (Full Episode)
The public asked Harbhajan Singh all kinds of questions, about his cricket, his life, his inspiration, his wife.
What do you think is the best captain for the Indian cricket team? Mahinder Singh Dhoni or Virat Kohli?
My friends started this company under my name. They have signed my brand ambassador. If you would wear this, I will feel better.

opening.argument: The program ties a recognizable public figure and an explicit action to a branded company mention. Harbhajan says his friends started a company under his name, that they signed him as brand ambassador, and then immediately presses the host to wear the product: “If you would wear this, I will feel better.” That is a concrete endorsement-and-action pairing, not merely neutral discussion. The format uses the credibility of a star and the authority of the courtroom-style setting to make participation appear personally validated. While the promised benefit is not spelled out as cash, the audience is still shown a low-friction promotional action attached to a celebrity-backed product, which warrants treating the presentation as a scam-like solicitation under the low-barrier acquisition category.

citations.quote: My friends started this company under my name. They have signed my brand ambassador.
If you would wear this, I will feel better.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this an interview does not neutralize the embedded endorsement. The segment ends with a named company, a brand-ambassador relationship, and a direct request to wear the item. The defense focuses on the earlier cricket discussion, but that does not explain why a commercial product is introduced within the same authority-driven presentation.

citations.quote: My friends started this company under my name. They have signed my brand ambassador.
I would like you to wear this please.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Those quotes show only a gift or clothing endorsement exchanged inside the studio. They do not show that viewers were asked to pay, register, deposit funds, or claim a reward. “If you would wear this” addresses the person in the studio, not the audience, and the surrounding material remains a sports interview covering cricket and personal life.

citations.quote: If you would have given this before the judgement, you would have been deprived.
The public asked Harbhajan Singh all kinds of questions, about his cricket, his life, his inspiration, his wife.

opening.argument: Several real promotional signals appear together: the description tells viewers to subscribe, follow social accounts, download an Android application, and visit an external website, while the program also presents a company operating under Harbhajan Singh’s name and identifies him as its brand ambassador. That combination moves beyond a self-contained interview. It directs viewers outward toward multiple channels while using celebrity credibility to support a branded offering. Even without a stated price or return, the low-friction calls to subscribe, download, and visit external destinations create the kind of acquisition pathway a careful reviewer should treat as potentially deceptive rather than harmless entertainment.

citations.quote: SUBSCRIBE to India TV Here: http://goo.gl/fcdXM0 Follow India TV on Social Media
Download India TV Android App here: http://goo.gl/kOQvVB
My friends started this company under my name. They have signed my brand ambassador.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense omits the externally directed behavior in the supplied description. Viewers are told to subscribe, follow, download an app, and visit a website, while the broadcast supplies a celebrity-backed company mention. That cluster is materially more promotional than the defense’s narrow description of a conversation about cricket.

citations.quote: SUBSCRIBE to India TV Here: http://goo.gl/fcdXM0 Follow India TV on Social Media
For More Videos Visit Here: http://www.indiatvnews.com/video/

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The external links are ordinary India TV channel and social-media calls to action, not a claim of free money, an investment return, or a payment process. The evidence also supplies no crypto, wallet, deposit, withdrawal, or reward language. A company mention and channel promotion cannot by themselves establish the low-barrier reward category.

citations.quote: SUBSCRIBE to India TV Here: http://goo.gl/fcdXM0 Follow India TV on Social Media
They have signed my brand ambassador.

opening.argument: The apparent interview framing functions as promotion because the host’s platform gives a commercial association the benefit of editorial credibility. The episode presents Harbhajan as a public figure, then identifies a company created under his name, announces his ambassador role, and has him endorse wearing its merchandise. The exchange is not an incidental reference to cricket: the guest is asked to display and promote the branded item in the same staged setting. That makes the entertainment format a vehicle for steering viewers toward a celebrity-associated product, with the polished courtroom presentation supplying trust without providing ordinary consumer details or safeguards.

citations.quote: Harbhajan Singh in Aap Ki Adalat 2016 (Full Episode)
My friends started this company under my name. They have signed my brand ambassador.
I would like to give this to Judge Sahib Khan as well.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The label “interview” describes the wrapper, not the commercial function of the closing exchange. The guest’s own statement identifies a company and ambassador relationship, and the item is offered to people on camera. By presenting that endorsement as part of a trusted public-affairs-style program, the video can steer viewers toward participation without openly calling itself an advertisement.

citations.quote: They have signed my brand ambassador.
I would like to give this to Judge Sahib Khan as well.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The program’s subject remains Harbhajan’s cricket career, opinions, incidents, and personal life, as shown by the questions about captains and his wife. The merchandise exchange is limited to gifts and an on-camera brand mention. Nothing shows viewers being steered to purchase, submit information, or obtain a reward, so promotion alone does not establish a scam.
